status: documentation compatibility review; no live execution evidence

sources.observation: Streamable HTTP MCP accepts custom server.headers. Calls carry X-Call-Id; chats carry X-Chat-Id and session chats also X-Session-Id. Tool calls can use new MCP connections.
sources.implementation: call.rs supplies the explicit setup bearer and shttp protocol; admission.rs verifies these headers against protected state and the private API.

sources.observation: Request-supplied server URLs do not inherit organization credentials under the documented rollout. Explicit request server.headers is a documented authentication option.
sources.implementation: The setup supplies its own per-invocation Authorization header; it does not depend on a saved organization credential being attached.

sources.observation: Session creation stores supplied variableValues in session.metadata.variableValues.
sources.implementation: vapi_origin.rs verifies the original protected nonce at that session metadata path rather than accepting incoming header selectors as authority.

sources.observation: Assistant overrides support inline tools through tools:append.
sources.implementation: Per-invocation setup appends its MCP tool while preserving the saved assistant definition.

limits: Documentation agreement is not evidence of successful live Vapi discovery, invocation, audio or model follow-through.
Actual cloud header propagation, saved resource verification and tool results must still be captured in the separately invoked bounded rehearsal.
No provider account, resource, public callback ingress or deployment was accessed or changed.
